owner.description: GitHub account whose App installation is swept.

appSlug.description: Slug of the App authoring the checks; heads carrying a check from another author are not treated as published.

cacheRoot.description: Directory holding the per-repository mirrors and worktrees.

budgetSeconds.description: Wall-clock the pass may spend starting heads. A dedicated runner affords far more than a controller's idle tick.

maximumPublications.description: Upper bound on heads started in one pass, independent of the time budget.
